record.original_question: Fix r >= 3 and write m = ar + b with a a non-negative integer and 1 <= b <= r. Among all non-r-partite K_{r+1}-free graphs with m edges, which graph has the largest spectral radius?

evidence.quote: Problem 11 (Lou, Lu and Zhai [31], 2025). For every r >= 3 and every positive integer m = ar + b, where a is a non-negative integer and 1 <= b <= r, what is the extremal graph with maximal spectral radius over all non-r-partite Kr+1-free graphs on m edges?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $r\ge 3$ be an integer. The spectral radius of a finite simple graph $G$ is the largest eigenvalue $\lambda(G)$ of its adjacency matrix. A graph is called $r$-partite if its vertex set admits a partition into $r$ independent sets; otherwise it is non-$r$-partite. A graph is $K_{r+1}$-free if it contains no clique on $r+1$ vertices.

For a positive integer $m$, write $m = ar + b$ where $a$ is a non-negative integer and $1 \le b \le r$. Among all non-$r$-partite, $K_{r+1}$-free graphs with exactly $m$ edges (and no isolated vertices, equivalently considered up to isolated vertices), determine the graph (or graphs) attaining the maximum spectral radius, and give the value of this maximum spectral radius as a function of $r$ and $m$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question by Lou, Lu and Zhai (2025) regarding the spectral extremal graph among non-r-partite K_{r+1}-free graphs of given size m. Related results address the case of given order n or specific small r, but the size version with the structural constraint of being non-r-partite appears unresolved in the search results.

status_evidence.title: Spectral Radius of Graphs with Given Size and Odd Girth
status_evidence.snippet: Studies spectral radius problems on graphs with prescribed number of edges, related to non-bipartite triangle-free extremal questions.
status_evidence.claim: Related size-version spectral problems are actively studied; the specific non-r-partite K_{r+1}-free size question remains open.

status_evidence.title: Maximum K_{r+1}-free graphs which are not r-partite
status_evidence.snippet: Edge-extremal (Turán-type) version of non-r-partite K_{r+1}-free graphs of given order.
status_evidence.claim: The order-version extremal problem is studied; spectral analogue with given size is the open problem in question.
